listing.name: 50 Cent: Blood on the Sand — Skullburglar (nlwstein)
listing.summary: The project claims all nine story missions are playable on all four platforms and reports a limited 36-minute run. Portcove has not confirmed these results. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 disc; the launcher extracts its files. This guide does not include the exact supported region, media ID or revision; check the project’s BUILDING instructions or importer requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s skullburglar.stz.sh launcher and downloads for the player. The GitHub issue-12-test-build asset is a test build, not a stable release channel. The documented players target Apple Silicon macOS, Linux/Steam Deck and native Windows.

warnings: The project claims all nine story missions are playable on all four platforms and reports a limited 36-minute run. Portcove has not confirmed these results.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
